Комплексная процедура оценки, в которой: A comprehensive assessment procedure in which a participant's behavior is observed in simulation exercises by several trained assessors.
Периодическая процедура определения соот: A periodic procedure for determining whether an employee fits the position held, governed by an internal regulation.
Период вхождения работника в должность,: The period in which an employee settles into a position, learning the work, the organization's rules and working relationships.
Эталонное значение показателя, с которым: A reference value of a metric used for comparison: an industry average, a peer-group average or a target value.
Свойство процедуры измерять именно то, ч: The property of a procedure to measure exactly what it is meant to measure: a leadership assessment that measures eloquence is not valid.
Число, задающее вклад частного критерия: A number that sets the contribution of a single criterion to a composite indicator. The weights are usually normalized to sum to one.
Способность работников замещать друг дру: The ability of employees to cover for each other without loss of quality; it reduces the risk of one person's absence.
Предложение о включении работника в кадр: A proposal to add an employee to the talent pool, made by the manager, HR or the employee.
Среднее число подготовленных преемников: The average number of prepared successors per critical position; it shows whether there is enough backup if the first candidate drops out.
Степень подготовленности резервиста к пр: How prepared a talent pool member is to take on the target position, expressed as a level or a composite index value.
Уровень должности в единой системе уровн: The level of a position in the organization's grading system, which defines requirements, authority and pay range.
Сопоставление фактических уровней компет: A comparison of actual competency levels with the target levels of the position profile; the result is a list of gaps to be closed.
Матрица размещения работников по двум ос: A matrix that places employees on two axes, performance and potential, with nine zones, each associated with its own decision.
Устойчивость результата процедуры: повто: The consistency of a procedure's result: repeating the measurement under the same conditions should give a similar result.
Документ, определяющий обязанности, прав: A document that defines an employee's duties, rights and responsibilities in their position.
Последовательность состояний от выдвижен: The sequence of states from a candidate's nomination to appointment or removal from the talent pool.
Формализованное обращение о включении ра: A formal request to add an employee to the talent pool, reviewed by the manager and HR.
Композитный показатель по шкале 0–100, с: A composite indicator on a 0–100 scale that combines individual readiness criteria into a single comparable number.
Перечень мероприятий с закреплёнными сро: A list of activities with assigned deadlines and owners that closes an employee's identified competency gaps.
Наблюдаемое проявление компетенции, опис: An observable manifestation of a competency, described so that different experts assign it to the same scale level.
Коллегиальный орган, принимающий решения: A collective body that decides on talent pool membership and appointments based on the assessment data presented.
Группа работников, отобранных по результ: A group of employees selected through assessment and undergoing targeted preparation to fill specific positions.
Процедура согласования оценок между руко: A procedure for aligning ratings across managers so that "high potential" means the same thing in different units.
Последовательность должностей, по которо: The sequence of positions an employee moves through in the organization, with the requirements of each move.
Должность, освобождение которой создаёт: A position whose vacancy creates a risk to the organization's operations; the main object of succession planning.
Наблюдаемая характеристика поведения, не: An observable behavioral characteristic required for successful performance, expressed through proficiency levels.
Показатель, полученный сведением несколь: An indicator obtained by combining several weighted individual indicators into one comparable number.
Мера противоречивости суждений эксперта: A measure of how contradictory an expert's judgments are in the analytic hierarchy process; a value above 0.1 makes the resulting weights unusable.
Оценка последствий незакрытой вакансии д: An assessment of the impact of an unfilled vacancy on the organization's operations, expressed on a scale and reviewed when the structure changes.
Квадратная матрица суждений о относитель: A square matrix of judgments on the relative importance of criteria, used by the analytic hierarchy process to derive weights.
Метод получения весов критериев из попар: A method of deriving criterion weights from pairwise comparisons with a consistency check of the expert's judgments.
Показатель, характеризующий состояние ре: An indicator describing the state of the talent pool: share of ready candidates, position coverage, share of appointments from the pool.
Опытный работник, сопровождающий подгото: An experienced employee who supports a talent pool member's preparation: shares practice, gives feedback and confirms results.
Форма развития, при которой подготовка в: A form of development in which preparation happens through regular interaction of a mentor–mentee pair over a set period.
Приведение разнородных показателей к еди: Bringing heterogeneous indicators to a common scale so that they are comparable and can be aggregated into a composite indicator.
Доля критичных должностей, для которых о: The share of critical positions with at least one identified successor.
Сообщение работнику наблюдений о его раб: Sharing observations about an employee's work in order to change behavior; unlike assessment, it is forward-looking.
Процедура сбора оценок работника от руко: A procedure for collecting ratings of an employee from the manager, peers, direct reports and the employee; it shows perception, not results.
Определение способности работника успешн: Determining an employee's ability to succeed in a position of greater complexity.
Систематическая подготовка внутренних ка: Systematic preparation of internal candidates for critical positions, with successor lists and readiness tracking.
Документ по конкретной критичной должнос: A document for a specific critical position containing a ranked list of successors and the dates by which they will be ready.
Измеримая характеристика достигнутого ре: A measurable characteristic of work results achieved over a period.
Способность работника развиваться и спра: An employee's ability to grow and handle more complex tasks; assessed separately from performance.
Работник, включённый в план замещения ко: An employee included in the succession plan for a specific position, with a rank and an expected readiness date.
Совокупность требований к должности: обр: The set of requirements for a position: education, tenure, management experience and weighted target competency levels.
Сопоставление фактических уровней компет: A comparison of an employee's actual competency levels with the position profile requirements, including an assessment coverage indicator.
Формы развития, встроенные в работу: раз: Forms of development built into work: stretch assignments, rotation, secondments, project work. They account for most of the growth in readiness.
Недобор фактического уровня компетенции: The shortfall of the actual competency level against the target level of the position profile; exceeding the target is not a gap.
Порядковый номер преемника в плане замещ: A successor's position in the succession plan, reflecting the order of consideration when the position becomes vacant.
Упорядочение кандидатов по значению комп: Ordering candidates by a composite indicator; the result must be checked for robustness to changes in weights.
Работник, включённый в кадровый резерв н: An employee in the talent pool for a specific target position who is being prepared under an individual plan.
Плановое перемещение работника между дол: A planned move of an employee between positions or business lines to broaden experience and test readiness for a new role.
Способ объединения нормированных частных: A way of combining normalized individual scores into a composite indicator: weighted sum, TOPSIS and others.
Временное закрепление работника за друго: A temporary assignment of an employee to another position or unit to perform real tasks under supervision.
Группа работников с высокой результативн: A group of high-performing, high-potential employees seen as the source of the talent pool.
Отношение числа выбывших работников к ср: The ratio of employees who left to the average headcount over a period; high turnover in critical positions makes the talent pool more expensive.
Ступень шкалы компетенции, описанная чер: A step on a competency scale described through observable behavior, from awareness to expert mastery.
Свойство порядка кандидатов сохраняться: The property of a candidate order to stay the same when criterion weights change within reasonable limits; checked by sensitivity analysis.
Должность, к замещению которой готовится: The position a talent pool member is being prepared to fill; competency gaps and the readiness index are calculated against it.
Способ получения весов из фактического р: A way of deriving weights from the actual spread of data: a criterion with little spread barely distinguishes candidates and gets a small weight.
Оценка результата работы наставнической: An assessment of a mentoring pair's results based on achieving the goal, not on the number of meetings held.
Компетенции, требуемые от всех работнико: Competencies required of all employees regardless of position; they express the organization's way of working.
Метод многокритериального выбора, ранжир: A multi-criteria decision method that ranks alternatives by their relative closeness to the ideal solution and distance from the worst one.
Работник с высоким потенциалом: способны: A high-potential employee: able to grow faster and take on tasks of significantly greater complexity.
Ключевой показатель результативности, по: A key performance indicator used to assess how well an employee or unit achieves its goals.
Поддержка работника при выходе из органи: Support for an employee leaving the organization: job search assistance, references and transition support.
Критичное требование профиля должности,: A critical requirement of the position profile; failing it prevents admission to the talent pool regardless of the overall match.
Перемещение работника на должность более: Moving an employee to a higher management level, as opposed to horizontally expanding responsibilities.
Перемещение на должность сопоставимого у: A move to a position of comparable level in another business line; it broadens experience without promotion.
Упражнение оценочной процедуры, в которо: An assessment exercise in which a participant's behavior is observed while the group works toward a joint decision.
Собеседование по заранее заданному переч: An interview based on a predefined set of questions that is the same for all candidates, ensuring comparable results.
Сводное представление кадрового потенциа: A summary view of the organization's talent: who is considered for which positions and over what horizon.
Освоение содержания работы через выполне: Learning the job by performing tasks under the guidance of a more experienced colleague.
Форма, заполняемая самим работником: даё: A form completed by the employee, used to compare self-assessment with others' ratings.
Граница шкалы, разделяющая уровни готовн: A point on the scale that separates readiness levels: an index above the threshold moves a talent pool member to the next level.
Совокупность признаков, по которым оцени: The set of traits used to assess an employee's capacity to grow: learning agility, breadth of thinking, tolerance for uncertainty.
Рабочее поручение, требующее умений уров: A work assignment that requires skills above the current level; the main form of on-the-job development.
Ранжированный перечень преемников по кон: A ranked list of successors for a specific position showing the order of consideration.
Проверка качества прежних кадровых решен: Checking the quality of past staffing decisions against the actual results of the people appointed.
Срок, за который назначенный работник до: The time it takes an appointed employee to reach planned performance; usually half as long for an internal candidate.
Последовательное рассмотрение выдвижения: Sequential review of a nomination by the line manager and HR, with the decision and its grounds recorded.
Совокупность мер, снижающих вероятность: Measures that reduce the likelihood of a valuable employee leaving; for the "star" zone it is the main risk, more important than development.
Уровень владения компетенцией, требуемый: The proficiency level required by the position profile; the difference from the actual level is the gap.
Оценка уровня владения компетенцией спец: An assessment of competency proficiency by a subject matter expert, used where testing is not applicable.
